documents.title: WebGLRenderingContext
documents.summary: The WebGLRenderingContext interface provides an interface to the OpenGL ES 2.0 graphics rendering context for the drawing surface of an HTML <canvas> element.

body: The <mark>WebGLRenderingContext</mark> interface provides an interface to the OpenGL ES 2.0 graphics rendering <mark>context</mark> for the drawing

<mark>Web</mark><mark>GLRendering</mark><mark>Context</mark>.scissor()
Defines the scissor box.
<mark>Web</mark><mark>GLRendering</mark><mark>Context</mark>.viewport()
Sets the viewport.

documents.title: WebGLRenderingContext: enable() method
documents.summary:
The WebGLRenderingContext.enable() method of the WebGL API enables specific WebGL capabilities
for this context.

body:
The <mark>Web</mark><mark>GLRendering</mark><mark>Context</mark>.enable() method of the <mark>Web</mark>GL API enables specific <mark>Web</mark>GL capabilities
for this <mark>context</mark>.
